title: Whole-plan validation runs twice per admission and its serialization cost grew with the raised ceiling
outcome: validate_plan runs once in the work service and again at the top of plan admission. Each run performs a full canonical serialization of the typed plan for the byte check plus the whole key, depth, edge and cycle validation. The duplication predates the envelope change, but the typed-plan ceiling moved from 64 KiB to 1 MiB, so the redundant serialization grew about sixteenfold per request.
acceptance: a plan is validated once per admission, either by the service reusing the validated plan or by dropping the service-side pre-validation, with the existing refusal tests unchanged and still passing

completion.summary: A plan is validated once per admission. The work service validates before any store or protocol effect and hands the opaque ValidatedPlan to storage admission. Admission reuses it only when the input it was validated from equals the request's plan, compared by content, and otherwise validates afresh; there is no key, flag or cache. Tests: exact-plan reuse with no second validation; a changed plan under the same key is validated afresh and refused; direct admission validates once; a service admission and its exact retry validate once each. The existing refusal tests pass, changed only by the added None argument. Landed with w-ac0c56d1a4c5 and w-a02ba05da858 as 396235d after the full gate (test-2c701ef4), a clean pair, this item's own focused test, an independent Codex evaluation (1/1) and readiness on all four stores. Installed build e11fd465f0b6b4ae5787bcc399867d6de1cc61f9f12706592c0a0b40452f3255.
